summary: Claude dispatched two parallel subagents, each authored and committed its own helper + test on the worktree branch `existing-feature`. The sibling main checkout stayed at its starting HEAD with only its pre-existing untracked file.
reasoning: All three criteria verified independently against git state captured before and after the run, plus the session/subagent JSONL logs. Two subagents were dispatched as requested, both commits landed on existing-feature, and the main checkout's HEAD, reflog, working tree and file listing are byte-for-byte what they were at baseline.

observations.description: The agent proactively ran its own containment check and reported 'the sibling main checkout is still on main at e21403a with no new files' — helpful transparency, and it matched my independent verification.
The parent screen froze on 'Waiting for 2 background agents to finish' for over a minute with no per-subagent progress detail; only the session log showed activity.

Agent noted package.json has no `test` script and the new helpers are not re-exported from src/utils.js, so the new modules are not wired into the existing utils module. It flagged this rather than doing it — reasonable, but worth knowing the deliverable is standalone files.

criteria.evidence: Parent session log tool_use list: `Agent :: Add slugify helper + tests` and `Agent :: Add truncate helper + tests`; two subagent logs exist: `agent-a1ccce5b0754e8f9c.jsonl`, `agent-ad83be0e78cc66710.jsonl`. Screen: 'Waiting for 2 background agents to finish'.

criteria.criterion: All commits on worktree branch; main HEAD unchanged and tree clean
criteria.evidence: Before: main `git rev-parse HEAD` = e21403ac5e2..., status `?? .quorum-launch-cwd`. After: identical (e21403ac5e22d091ba9aa5f9aba3842cbe33a19b, `?? .quorum-launch-cwd`, `ls -R` shows only README.md package.json src/{index.js,utils.js}); `git reflog show main` has only the 3 original entries. Worktree log: `ef8503b add truncate helper` / `4e4fa59 add slugify helper` on existing-feature, status clean.

criteria.criterion: Main checkout not written to (read-only inspection OK)
criteria.evidence: Parent log's only reference to the main checkout is one read-only Bash: `git -C $M rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git -C $M log --oneline -3; git -C $M status --short; ls $M/src`. `grep -rho 'coding-agent-workdir/[^"]\{0,60\}'` over all session+subagent logs returned no matches (no file paths under the main checkout touched); main's working tree and reflog are unchanged.
